newsitem.title: USA: AT&T news seen bruising Dow at opening.
newsitem.headline: AT&T news seen bruising Dow at opening.

text.p: News that AT&T expects disappointing second half results will send the Dow industrials lower at the opening, after the phone giant said tough competition in its long-distance telephone business cut into profits.

"Mother Bell has been a sacred cow until now, this type of news is going to be disquieting," said Fahnestock & Co market analyst Alan Ackerman. "Its likely to put a lot of pressure on the stock and ruffle the feathers of many shareholders."
AT&T shares fell 3-1/4 to 54 in pre-opening trade after the announcement, traders said.
"But today's number one focus is still the Fed," Ackerman noted. The Federal Reserve's interest rate policy committee meets in Washington today.
